report.explanation: Current evidence shows healthy signals: payment checkout span OK (60ms), order error_rate 0.0014, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. The deployment record only proves version facts and cannot establish latency causation. No observation substantiates any taxonomy cause, so hand off for more evidence rather than assert a root cause.
